_doc: Trust policy for Beacon's approval gate. First-match-wins; default_action applies when no rule matches. Edit this file to add carve-outs as Larry builds confidence in specific dispatch shapes. Reloaded on every evaluate() call so changes take effect without restart. See scripts/trust_policy.py for the evaluator and schema.

_rule_fields.source: agent/system that initiated the task. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.target: agent receiving the dispatch. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.task_type: label on the task envelope. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.repos: glob list against task.target_repo. [] matches any.
_rule_fields.file_patterns: glob list against task.changed_files. [] matches any.

_example_rules_disabled._note: Pulse-flagged doc-only changes in agent-core auto-approve. Uncomment to enable.

rules._note: Sensitive-intent carve-out for the pulse-auto-dispatch lane (#8, 2026-06-23). The broad pulse rule below auto-approves on target='*' with no path carve-out; this asks Larry first when a pulse dispatch DECLARES sensitive files (file_patterns) OR its text signals sensitive-infra work (match_sensitive_intent: the chokepoints stamp task['sensitive_intent'] from a tight summary/prompt keyword scan in trust_policy.SENSITIVE_INTENT_KEYWORDS, since a fresh dispatch carries no changed_files). MUST stay ordered BEFORE the pulse auto_approve rule (first-match-wins).

AUTONOMY (2026-06-22, Larry-approved). Pulse-auto-dispatch envelopes auto-fire without Larry's pre-build click. The envelope only asks Beacon to DRAFT A SPEC (target_agent=beacon, no build), always targeting ourliberty-agent-core (pulse_check_i._build_dispatch_envelope). Pulse auto-dispatches candidates that are effort in {small, medium} AND state a clear impact (pulse_check_i._is_auto_dispatch_eligible; WIDENED 2026-06-22 from the v1 effort=small + $-quantified filter — large-effort + impact-less proposals still park to the funnel). NOTE: effort is no longer an autonomy brake here — for the downstream Beacon->Forge->agent-core build the guards are the sensitive-path carve-out below (only on declared changed_files), classify_careful's keyword exclusion, Mirror REVIEW_PASS before any merge, and EMERGENCY_HALT/pause. This removes ONLY the 'draft a spec?' click. REVERT = set action back to force_ask (re-read on every evaluate(), no restart). Was force_ask (closed-loop v1, 2026-05-24).

Sensitive-path carve-out (2026-06-21; fresh-build hole closed 2026-06-23 #8). A Beacon→Forge agent-core dispatch that DECLARES it touches config/systemd/deploy/CI/migrations/account-tier/kill-switch/secrets still asks Larry. The old CAVEAT (file_patterns only match when the task carries changed_files — so a FRESH build with no declared files bypassed this) is now covered by match_sensitive_intent: the chokepoints (beacon_approval_handler.trust_decision + outbox_notifier's pulse twin) scan the dispatch summary/prompt with trust_policy.SENSITIVE_INTENT_KEYWORDS and stamp task['sensitive_intent'], which trips this rule. Remaining backstops for un-named sensitive work: Mirror's review + ESCALATE/halt before any merge. MUST stay ordered BEFORE the broad auto_approve rule (first-match-wins).

STAGE-2 PREREQUISITE (spec agents/beacon/specs/main-suite-green-guardian.md D3 / L4). The Main-Suite Green Guardian's auto-filed fix tasks touch ONLY scripts/tests/** — a source='suite-guardian' dispatch whose declared changed_files stay inside that allow-list auto-approves. Fix scope is ALSO enforced MECHANICALLY (not just on self-declared changed_files) by the outbox_notifier merge-eligibility diff gate: SHA-bound to headRefOid, re-checked immediately pre-merge, fail-closed on fetch failure, keyed off the ledger fix_task_id join — this JSON rule is only the policy-layer half. Under the 'conservative' dial the guardian is pinned <= Stage 1 by the dial map (so it never auto-files); this rule bites only at balanced/loose. Mirrored in trust_policy.policy_for_level (balanced+loose presets).

AUTONOMY (2026-06-21, Larry-approved 'low-risk code, agent-core'). Beacon→Forge dispatches targeting ourliberty-agent-core auto-fire without Larry's pre-build click. Downstream gates REMAIN fully in force — Mirror REVIEW_PASS before any auto-merge, file-overlap merge serializer, GitHub-truth merge confirmation, EMERGENCY_HALT, /pause. This removes ONLY the pre-dispatch human click; it never auto-merges unreviewed code. Sensitive paths are carved to force_ask by the preceding rule (see its CAVEAT). REVERT = delete this rule (re-read on every evaluate(), no restart). Other repos + pulse-auto-dispatch still force_ask.
